title: Over 3.85 lakh cases pending in 28 information commissions as of June 2026: report
description: The ‘Report Card on the Performance of Information Commissions in India, 2025-26’ says the number of appeals and complaints pending on June 30, 2026, in 28 information commissions stood at 3,85,716; in 2025, it was 4,13,972
